heading: From Idea to Merch — in 4 Steps
subtext: The entire process takes less than 15 minutes of your time. Prices are visible immediately — no calls or negotiations.

1.title: Choose a Product
1.body: Browse the catalog with real prices. The price updates immediately when you change quantity and print type. No calls needed to find out the cost.

2.title: Customize Online
2.body: Upload your logo, place it on the product, choose the print zone. The editor shows the exact cost for each zone in real time.

3.title: Get a Quote
3.body: Fill out the form — a manager will contact you within 2 hours. Fixed price with no hidden fees. Invoice immediately after confirmation.

4.title: Receive Your Merch
4.body: Production 7–14 business days. Delivery by Nova Poshta across Ukraine. If something is wrong — we redo it for free.
